csp.mdd: One long line. let me lay it out.
csp.label.in: Paste headers (a single CSP line is fine)
csp.status.built: Starts at the strictest and only opens what you picked
csp.find.noDefault: without default-src, anything you did not list is allowed from anywhere
csp.find.wildcard: a wildcard means it is effectively not locked down
csp.find.unsafeInline: allowing inline scripts or styles removes most XSS protection (use a nonce or hash)
csp.find.unsafeEval: allowing eval turns strings into code
csp.find.scriptData: data: and blob: scripts are a known bypass
csp.find.plainHttp: http:// can be rewritten in transit
csp.find.noObject: without object-src none, old plugin bypasses remain
csp.find.noFrameAncestors: without frame-ancestors your page can be framed (clickjacking)
csp.find.noBaseUri: without base-uri, a base tag can redirect every relative URL
csp.find.noFormAction: without form-action, a form can post to someone else
csp.find.noCsp: there is no CSP at all
csp.find.noHsts: no HSTS. the first visit can go over http
csp.find.shortHsts: the HSTS max-age is short (180 days or more is usual)
csp.find.noReferrer: no Referrer-Policy. URLs can leak to other sites
csp.find.noFrameOptions: neither framing protection header is set
csp.find.noPermissions: Permissions-Policy can switch off camera, mic and friends
